title: SANSARA | Soumya Nair  live at Sound Dhaba
description: Catch talented local South Asian musicians live at Sound Dhaba – an afternoon to remember in DTLA Arts District
long_description:
Catch talented local South Asian musicians live at Sound Dhaba – an afternoon to remember in DTLA Arts District

About this Event

Join us for another Fantastic Afternoon!
 and present SANSARA | Soumya Nair, as part of our monthly residency celebrating South Asian culture and talent in the heart of the DTLA Arts District.
✨Headliner: is a Global Indian singer-songwriter who creates genre-blending pop music, bringing together catchy melodies & heartfelt storytelling. For her upcoming semi-acoustic show at Sound Dhaba, expect a fun, feel-good mix of your favourite global pop songs, Bollywood hits, and Sansara originals!
For this show, Sansara’s Dream Team will feature
Guitar: Debjeet DamPercussion: Joey WatermanPiano: Anubhabh SenBacking Vocals: Sarah Maycoming together to create some really cool acoustic arrangements. Get ready for an evening of Sing Alongs!

🎶 Special Performance: "Letters to Asha Tai"
Vocalist and her band, Silk Sound, present a deeply personal musical tribute to the legendary playback singer Asha Bhosle. The show unfolds as a series of intimate musical "letters", each song an expression of admiration, gratitude and affection for an artist whose voice has been a constant companion through countless lives.

🎺 Opening Set: Acid Jazz Lounge
ARTRONIKA Executive Director improvises on trumpet and synths while DJ-ing an eclectic mix of world and electronic music. joins on tabla and global percussion.

🎨 Live Painting by 
Legendary artist Norton Wisdom paints throughout the afternoon, creating constantly changing, ephemeral images with watercolors on a fiberglass canvas.

🎲 Play: Carrom Board, Ludo and other popular Indian board games
🥟 Eat: Come early for complimentary Pani Puri (a delicious vegetarian Indian snack)
📍 Sound Dhaba, 2441 Hunter St, Los Angeles, CA 90021 (Arts District, Downtown LA)
🚗 Plenty of free street parking
👨‍👩‍👧 All ages welcome
Come jam out, enjoy amazing vibes and experience some live music magic with us!
